title: Isolate selected Parquet new upstream test classes
description: Retain the first frozen test selection and ranking. Re-run the exact five selected classes in their own fresh JVMs, each plain and traced in a privately hydrated original module, so upstream target files cannot collide and an unrelated overflowing test class cannot erase another class’s coverage. Preserve all parity failures and limits.
expected: Every selected original class is accounted for with per-class parity and raw loaded method evidence in the original deployment order.
